task: binary classification: P(soluble) for a peptide in a given solvent
esm_pooling: mean-pool per-residue last_hidden_state, BOS and EOS tokens excluded from the mean
solvent_join_key: solvent_key = normalize_solvent_name(solvent_name), joined against bundled solvent_descriptors.json

deployment_artifact.variant: Pipeline B raw (ESM2 embedding + solvent descriptors, no PCA)
deployment_artifact.split_strategy: pair_stratified: random 64/16/20 train/val/test split stratified on y (peptide-solvent pairs can appear across both train and test)
deployment_artifact.why_chosen: pipelineB.ipynb was read in full and contains no full-data refit step after the evaluation loop (the notebook ends at the LOSO summary in the final cell). All 6 cached B_raw artifacts are evaluation-fold models: pair_stratified and seq_disjoint each hold out a test partition, and the 4 loso_* files each hold out one entire solvent. There is no cached or in-notebook model trained on 100% of long_peptide_solvent.csv. Per the documented fallback rule, pair_stratified was selected as the most defensible deployment choice: it uses the largest train portion, is a standard random split (not group-held-out), and is closest in spirit to a general-purpose model. This is a FALLBACK, not an ideal full-data-refit deployment model — see README.md Provenance section.

evaluation_summary_from_prior_investigat.note_dmso: DMSO LOSO AUC ~0.56 (near chance-level) even in this best-performing (raw) variant
evaluation_summary_from_prior_investigat.note_coverage_gap: 3 of 7 solvents (0.2 M acetic acid, 3% ammonia water (v/v), HCOOH) are 100% single-class (all-soluble) in this dataset and were skipped in LOSO evaluation entirely -> zero held-out validation coverage for those solvents

not_used: model_cache/B_pca (PCA-reduced embedding variant; PCA transform was never persisted, unresolved reproducibility gap)
